Joseph Power, Jr., who practices law in Chicago, Illinois, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2005 - 2027. Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at Loyola University Chicago School of Law. He graduated in 1977. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1977.
